title: Pocketwire Rewards Training Note: The Everyday-Spend Milestone Supplement
content:
The everyday-spend supplement adds points to a Pocketwire Rewards quarterly milestone bonus according to how many grocery and dining earning entries the points ledger carries over the last three months.

## Rule

The milestone everyday-spend supplement is 600 points when the ledger carries at least 10 earning entries in the grocery or dining category dated within the last three months, 250 points when it carries at least 4 but fewer than 10, and nothing when it carries fewer than 4. The supplement is added to the quarterly milestone bonus credited, in whole points.

Earning entries are the entries that credit base and category points on a card purchase; boost entries, which carry the same purchase's spend, are not earning entries. A date lies within the last three months when it is later than the same calendar day three months before the handling date and not later than the handling date.

## Questions answered

Which entries count? Earning entries on the member's Pocketwire Rewards points ledger whose merchant category is grocery or dining, dated within the last three months. Grocery and dining entries are counted together.

Six grocery entries and five dining entries? Eleven in all: 600 points.

Three grocery entries and one boost entry at a grocer? The boost entry is not an earning entry, so three count: nothing.

Nine grocery or dining entries? 250 points.

## Count and supplement

| Grocery or dining earning entries within the last three months | Supplement |
|---|---|
| 10 or more | 600 points |
| 4 to 9 | 250 points |
| 3 or fewer | nothing |
